limits: 24 seconds of real wall time; requested canvas 30 fps is not a measured renderer frame rate.
Physical time can advance more slowly than wall time because the application caps per-frame simulation delta; both clocks and their ratio are reported.
Normal native SDR canvas and existing post-compressor stereo mix; no microphone or absolute nits/SPL calibration.
Timer cancellation is cooperative: JavaScript cannot preempt a blocked main thread or browser media encoder.
One evolving event with fixed camera; no paired timing, universal visual acceptance or GPU-performance claim.
The tool pauses afterward; it does not clear smoke, rewind physical time, reset wave/cloud history or restore a pre-event image.

radialScale.widthStatistic: maximum pairwise horizontal separation of eligible outer burning heads in shared free flight
radialScale.frame: shell-COM/carrier reference; finite-star arithmetic or mass-weighted centroid is not constrained
radialScale.contactPolicy: Free-flight pre-contact calibration only; existing physical/optical contact clipping may reduce actual burning width at any launch angle
radialScale.windPolicy: Common uniform-in-space piecewise-held wind/drag/gravity translation cancels pairwise; no wind callback or future sample queried
radialScale.physicalCalibration: Authored120m at2.5s/10% source gate; not a supplier measured expansion/photometry curve
radialScale.photometryAndMatter: I0, emission/material profiles, IDs, birth, lifetimes and tail recipes are not patched
radialScale.visibility: Source-relative reference geometry, not camera visibility; at0x this is explicitly nonvisible geometry

radianceProfile.normalization: Existing native I0 already includes user intensityScale; authored gain16 applied exactly once to emission RGB and emissionReferenceI0
radianceProfile.calibration: authored reference brightness and optical allocation; no measured candela, nits, radiated energy or fuel calibration

layerProfile.photometry: Authored gain16 of each R35 source reference exactly once, including all-phase RGB; user gain already included; no measured photometry. Original material and geometry retained.
layerProfile.material: No CDF scheduler or material allocation changed; downstream original model remains
